learning_outcomes.text: The aim is to impart rules and generally valid aspects to be observed when designing in mechanical engineering, in particular criteria for executing and dimensioning a design according to function, material, standards, manufacturing, and load. Participants will acquire knowledge of the standard and manufacturing-compliant execution of technical drawings for general mechanical engineering components and the ability to independently carry out design projects with the help of CAD.
To analyze problem statements in design engineering.
To describe criteria for function-, material-, standard-, manufacturing-, and load-compliant design.
To describe materials and their properties.
To calculate basic cases of component stress (tension, compression, shear, bending, torsion).
To verifiably carry out strength verifications for selected components based on the FKM guideline and simple stress cases.
To explain central aspects for the standard- and manufacturing-compliant execution of technical drawings for general mechanical engineering components.
To sketch views and sectional representations of mechanical engineering components according to standards and to carry out design projects with the help of CAD.
To determine dimensional tolerances, fits, form and position tolerances, and roughnesses of technical surfaces.
To solve calculation problems, distinguish suitable calculation methods, and justify one's own calculation method.
To comprehensibly argue design decisions and adopted designs for components and machine elements to professional colleagues.
To efficiently organize CAD projects with multiple components and assemblies – from modeling to drawing derivation.
To present work results (sketches, drawings, CAD models) appropriately for the audience.

syllabus_topics: Materials (determination of characteristic values, metallic materials, plastics)
Basic cases of component stress (tension, compression, shear, bending, torsion)
Compressive stress (pressure) when two components are in contact under force
Dimensioning for fatigue and endurance strength
Design in the manufacturing process – Manufacturing-compliant design
Standard-compliant drawing creation (views, section representations, details, threads, dimensioning, layout of a technical drawing)
Representation of selected form elements (undercuts, feather keys, circlips, screws, rolling bearings)
